defect.reproducer: Without remapping, patrol published geometry_msgs/msg/Twist on /cmd_vel with zero subscribers while turtlesim subscribed to /turtle1/cmd_vel with zero publishers; two pose samples three seconds apart were identical.
defect.root_cause: The relative publisher name cmd_vel resolved to /cmd_vel in the root namespace and did not match turtlesim's /turtle1/cmd_vel subscription.
defect.proof_after: Remapping cmd_vel to /turtle1/cmd_vel produced one publisher and one subscriber, changed the pose at linear velocity 0.5 and angular velocity 0.3, and measured approximately 10 Hz.
